description: This file defines a Perl package 'servers' that provides a comprehensive set of subroutines for managing test servers in a network testing environment. It includes functions for starting, stopping, and verifying various server types (HTTP, HTTPS, FTP, SSH, SFTP, MQTT, Socks, SMB, etc.), including support for IPv4, IPv6, Unix sockets, and TLS/SSL configurations. It also manages server process IDs, log files, and network ports, facilitating automated testing of network protocols.

methods.name: checkcmd
methods.description: Checks for the existence of a command in the system PATH or specified directories.

methods.name: getfreeport
methods.description: Creates a temporary server socket on an unused port and returns that port number.

methods.name: initserverconfig
methods.description: Initializes server configuration variables, including temporary socket paths and user information.

methods.name: init_serverpidfile_hash
methods.description: Prepopulates hashes with filenames for server process IDs and ports for various protocols.

methods.name: clearlocks
methods.description: Kills processes holding file locks in a given directory, primarily on Windows.

methods.name: checkdied
methods.description: Checks if a process with a given PID has just died and reaps it if so.

methods.name: serverfortest
methods.description: Ensures that appropriate servers are running for a specific test scenario.

methods.name: startnew
methods.description: Starts a new process with given command, writes PID to a file if needed, and waits for it to become available.

methods.name: protoport
methods.description: Returns the network port associated with a given protocol from internal configuration.

methods.name: stopserver
methods.description: Stops a server and all server processes that are related to it, cleans up files and processes.

methods.name: getexternalproxyflags
methods.description: Returns command-line flags for using an external HTTP proxy.

methods.name: verifyhttp
methods.description: Verifies if a server is running on a specific IP and port and is responsive.

methods.name: verifyftp
methods.description: Verifies if an FTP or FTPS server is running and responsive on a specific IP and port.

methods.name: verifyrtsp
methods.description: Verifies if an RTSP server is running and responsive.

methods.name: verifyssh
methods.description: Verifies if an SSH server is alive by checking its PID file.

methods.name: verifysftp
methods.description: Checks if an SFTP server is accessible, and performs a test command.

methods.name: verifyhttptls
methods.description: Verifies a non-stunnel HTTPS/TLS server using curl, checking for specific signing or TLS indicators.

methods.name: verifysocks
methods.description: Stub for verifying SOCKS servers, primarily checking if process is alive.

methods.name: verifysmb
methods.description: Stub for verifying SMB servers.

methods.name: verifytelnet
methods.description: Verifies if a Telnet server responds and is responsive.

methods.name: verifyserver
methods.description: General function that dispatches to specific protocol verification functions, retrying a number of times.

methods.name: responsiveserver
methods.description: Single shot check to verify server responsiveness.

methods.name: runhttpserver
methods.description: Starts and verifies an HTTP server, handling IPv4, IPv6, Unix sockets, and verification.

methods.name: runhttp2server
methods.description: Starts and verifies an HTTP/2 server.

methods.name: runhttp3server
methods.description: Starts and verifies an HTTP/3 server.

methods.name: runhttpsserver
methods.description: Starts and verifies an HTTPS server with stunnel.

methods.name: runhttptlsserver
methods.description: Starts and verifies a non-stunnel HTTP/TLS server.

methods.name: runpingpongserver
methods.description: Starts a pingpong (FTP, SMTP, IMAP, POP3) server and verifies responsiveness.

methods.name: runsecureserver
methods.description: Starts and verifies a secure server with TLS/SSL, including certificate support.

methods.name: runtftpserver
methods.description: Starts a TFTP server and verifies it.

methods.name: runrtspserver
methods.description: Starts and verifies an RTSP server.

methods.name: runsshserver
methods.description: Starts a SSH server, verifies it, and reads key fingerprint files.

methods.name: runmqttserver
methods.description: Starts an MQTT server.

methods.name: runsocksserver
methods.description: Starts a SOCKS server.

methods.name: rundictserver
methods.description: Starts a dictionary server.

methods.name: runsmbserver
methods.description: Starts an SMB server.

methods.name: stopservers
methods.description: Stops all running test servers, kills related processes, and cleans up PID files.

methods.name: subvariables
methods.description: Performs variable substitution within command or file contents based on server configuration and environment variables.
